notes_2026_08_17: RE-SCOPED (Q-079 audit + red-team). Wiring nTrials ALONE would change the headline from 1 to 1. Since expectedMaxSharpe scales as 1/sqrt(T-1) (lib/quant/deflatedSharpe.ts:117), T and nTrials are COUPLED. Caveat: the distributional moments are not persisted, so those figures assume g3=0,g4=3 — direction and magnitude robust, third decimal soft.
